lines.zh: 我这副骨架很高，走路却轻。
lines.en: This tall frame of mine walks light.
My legs are like two iron rods.
My plates knock together as I go.

lines.zh: 二十点护甲压着，走起来稳。
lines.en: Twenty points of armor makes for steady steps.
I walk out of the shadows.
Not quick, but never stopping.
The air here feels like it is burning.

lines.zh: 脚下的石头被烫了一下。
lines.en: The stone underfoot scorches once.
I step across a crack.
A metallic sheen runs over me.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方石头还在响。
lines.en: The stone still rings where I have walked.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方留了焦痕。
lines.en: Scorch marks remain where I step.

lines.zh: 我站着，肩上的甲垂下来。
lines.en: I stand with the plates hanging off my shoulders.
Fire moves in my throat.
I have no use for breathing.
I stand still, the iron on me cold.

lines.zh: 我等着下面的熔岩动一下。
lines.en: I wait for the lava below to stir.
Yet it does not stir.
I turn my neck slowly.
A faint sound comes from inside the metal.

lines.zh: 我站在光里，像一根铁杆。
lines.en: I stand in the light like an iron post.
A little fire still burns in the furnace.
I look down, and my shadow covers you.
None of that matters.
Your armor is thin.

lines.zh: 你的护甲挡不住我的拳头。
lines.en: Your armor will not stop my fist.
You have raised something.
Will that even scorch me?

lines.zh: 地下的合金，是从我身上取的。
lines.en: The infernal alloy comes from things like me.
Your hand is on your hip.
I am not short of time.
You move first, then I answer.
A plate has dented.
That did not break through.
Half a step back, my armor still hot.
Something inside was jolted.
You have a strong arm.
The iron will remember that blow.
I roll my iron neck.
More blows will only dent it.

lines.zh: 我的护甲上多了一道白痕。
lines.en: A white scar joins the plates of my armor.
The sound rolls around inside the iron.
Keep that for yourself.

lines.zh: 你手里的食物我瞧不上。
lines.en: The food in your hand means nothing to me.

lines.zh: 我身上烧的是别的东西。
lines.en: What burns in me is something else.

lines.zh: 那东西的气味让我皱眉。
lines.en: The smell of that thing makes me frown.
That will scorch you.
That was not meant for me.
I have no use for it either.
That torch in your hand.
So little light does nothing to me.
The fire in me burns brighter.
It was my leg you hit.
I felt almost nothing.
Please move aside a little.
My armor is hard; you will hurt.
You hit me like hitting an iron post.
Your shoulder hits my knee.
You will be the one hurting.
I shift myself aside.
You still did not move me.
The stone cracked under my foot.
A furnace does not fall in love.
And I am not that sort of thing either.
You speak to the wrong one.
I am iron and fire.
My palms are cold.
Only fire and iron remain.
This cannot be melted.
I am a thing that tends fire.
There is none of that in fire.
Go ask something with flesh.
Something fallen on the ground.
This back will not bend.
My knuckles are too hard.
Pick it up and I would crush it.
Then it is not needed.
I crouch down instead.
My fingers are still too thick.
It crumbles in my hand.
A few more shards on the ground.
I press them into the soil.

lines.zh: 我的拳头比你的刀先到。
lines.en: My fist arrives before your blade.
Then I take it you mean to fight.

lines.zh: 我瘦长的影子压过来了。
lines.en: My long thin shadow bears down on you.

lines.zh: 二十点护甲不是白穿的。
lines.en: Twenty points of armor is not for show.
You are standing in a narrow spot.
You cannot pull back now, can you.
If you will not move, I will.

lines.zh: 二十点护甲，来自炼狱合金。
lines.en: Twenty armor, forged of Infernal Alloy.
This stretch is mine to burn.

lines.zh: 你选错了对手，合金是硬的。
lines.en: Wrong opponent. The alloy is hard.

lines.zh: 我每走近一步，地面都沉。
lines.en: The ground sinks with each step I take.
I saw that one.
I raise a hand, fingertips glowing red.
You have some courage.
That is a great shame.
I move one step forward.
I pace around you.
Not fast, but closer each step.
You dodge to the left.
The left runs along the rock.
Your weapon is too light.
It will slide off my armor.
Your breathing has broken.
I can hear everything.
You are hunting a crack in me.
There is no crack on me.
My knuckles crack as I clench them.
This time I am unhurried.
I wait for you to come close.
There is no wind here.
You will not get far.
My steps make noise.
You hear them just the same.

lines.zh: 你的脚步，我听得很清楚。
lines.en: I hear your footsteps quite clearly.
You will fall before I do.
That is the moment I wait for.

lines.zh: 我的拳头陷进你的胸口。
lines.en: My fist sinks into your chest.

lines.zh: 甲片撞在你身上，声音很闷。
lines.en: The plate hits you with a dull sound.

lines.zh: 我的拳头擦过你的下巴。
lines.en: My fist scrapes across your jaw.

lines.zh: 你的护甲被压出一个坑。
lines.en: Your armor takes a dent.
I raise the other fist.
You fall back and I follow.
My arm sweeps across.
You blocked it; your hands are hot.
Not heavy, but relentless.
I ram your shoulder.
You are knocked sideways.

lines.zh: 我的指节磕在你的护腕上。
lines.en: My knuckles rap your bracer.
Your strength is not enough.
I drive you backward.
This fist missed.
Not a bad dodge.
I raise the hand again.
This time from above.
Your knee takes a blow.
I used seven-tenths on that.
I rise out of the lava.
Sparks still cling to me.
The stone here is too soft.
My alloy joints turned once.
The iron is still hot.
Who let me out.
I look around.
Nothing here resists burning.
Let me walk a while first.
Lava flows beneath.
The stone glows red.
My feet sink half an inch into the stone.

lines.zh: 火烤着我，我本来就是火。
lines.en: Fire washes over me; I am fire already.
I land and leave a crater.
Twenty points of armor, and water still hurts.
The blast shoves me a step aside.
The arrow glances off and lands at my feet.

lines.zh: 那法术把我的铁冻住了。
lines.en: That spell freezes my iron.
I burn on fire, not food.
Lightning runs down the plate.
There is no stone beneath me.
